title_suggestion: The Secret Note That Changed History
style: Semi-realistic 3D character rendering with slightly exaggerated head proportions. Warm interior home lighting transitions to gloomy cemetery blues and moody office desk illumination. Dynamic camera moves close in on emotional reactions and key physical props like letters and journal entries.
narration: Dramatic and reflective narrative tone spoken at a steady, measured pace.
never_change: Central focus on the mother-son emotional connection and the pivotal written letter.

facts.detail: A young boy delivers a sealed note from his teacher to his mother.
The mother quietly reads the message and begins to weep.
The boy asks his mother about the contents of the letter.
She claims the note commends him as a genius unfit for regular schooling, promising to teach him herself.
The mother educates the boy at home as he studies diligently over the years.
Years pass, and the mother eventually passes away.
Decades later, the grown boy discovers the original folded letter inside a desk drawer.
He discovers the letter actually declared him mentally unfit for school and expelled him.
Overwhelmed with emotion, Thomas Edison logs in his diary how his mother's belief forged his success.

points: A young student brings home a confidential letter from his instructor.
clips.visual: Boy enters through doorway and hand-delivers paper to his mother.

points: The mother reads the letter privately and grows tearful.
clips.visual: Close-up on mother opening document, eyes filling with tears as son inquires.

points: She lies about the note, calling him a genius who will be taught at home.
clips.visual: Mother wipes tears, smiles, and reassures her son while holding his face.

points: She acts as his dedicated tutor until her passing years later.
clips.visual: Transition from home study desk scene to adult man placing flowers at a headstone.

points: As a successful adult, he stumbles upon the original note in a desk.
clips.visual: Camera tracks down over an office desk as man unearths paper hidden in a drawer.

points: The true contents state he was expelled for being mentally lacking.
clips.visual: Over-the-shoulder shot showing text describing dismissal due to low intellect.

points: Thomas Edison reflects on how a mother's faith defined his legacy.
clips.visual: Man writes emotional entry in journal next to a framed photo of his mother.
